units.source_text: 等等！……刚才那响声是怎么回事？

en.t: Wait! ... What was that sound just now?
... I cannot hear it anymore ... I probably imagined it.

units.source_text: 然而，村落的灯究竟都到哪儿去了呢？

en.t: But where on earth had the village lights gone?

units.source_text: 就算地形再复杂，也有些不对劲了吧。

en.t: No matter how complicated the terrain was, something still seemed wrong.

units.source_text: 能够想象的只有这种情况：

en.t: There was only one situation he could imagine:

units.source_text: 舵总是偏左，迂回到海角那边，所以，那里高高的棱线就此挡住了村子……

en.t: The rudder kept veering left, making him circle around toward the cape, and so the high ridge there had blocked the village from view ...
He could not keep dawdling like this ...

units.source_text: 下决心靠右，转换方向试试。

en.t: He resolved to keep to the right and try changing direction.
